[SWS_DM_01079] Session check for DDID
⌈
On reception of service ’Dy-
namicallyDefineDataIdentifier’ with subfunction ’defineByIdentifier’, the DM shall check
if the DDID can be defined in the current session according to [SWS_DM_00413]. If
the DDID cannot be defined in the current session, the DM shall return an NRC 0x31
(requestOutOfRange).
⌋
